name: "Morto, Matado, Morrido" by Diogo Potes
description: Discover the vibrant and thought-provoking paintings of Diogo Potes at this contemporary gallery space.
longDescription:
"Morto, Matado, Morrido" is an art exhibition showcasing the paintings of Diogo Potes, presented at Viga Galeria. The exhibition features a collection of contemporary works by Potes, known for his distinctive approach to painting. This presentation offers insight into his artistic practice and current themes.

Visitors to Viga Galeria will encounter a series of artworks displayed within the gallery's contemporary setting. The exhibition provides an opportunity to engage with Potes's visual language and the narratives embedded in his pieces. The environment of Viga Galeria is designed to facilitate the viewing of modern art.

Admission to "Morto, Matado, Morrido" is free. The exhibition runs from September 24 to October 10, 2026. Viga Galeria is located in Porto, accessible via public transport and within walking distance of central areas.
